messages.subject: blavaan 0.4-3
parts:
blavaan 0.4-3 is now on CRAN. You will hopefully notice speed-ups for many models. There are also some new target options: target="vb" for variational Bayes and target="cmdstanr" to use the cmdstanr package instead of rstan. In both cases, the model from target="stan" is used.

Ed
